subject: HQ visit — staggered checkpoints, demo gear list, and NDA/escort plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumentech.com>
To: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: HQ visit — integration demo + exec tour

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. We'd like to bring a mixed delegation to Redwood's HQ for a half-day integration demo and executive walkthrough. Tentative headcount: ~18 (6 execs, 10 engineers, 2 technical leads).

Ideally we would do a single-day visit the week of Mar 21–25; preferred day is Thu, Mar 24. Main asks:
- 90 minute hands-on demo slot (networked demo machines)
- 30 minute exec overview + Q&A
- Secure room for code-sharing / breakouts for engineers
- NDA in place before attendees arrive

Can you confirm availability and any visitor requirements (badges, parking, escort)? We may bring two laptops with PCIe accelerators and would like to test a wired connection to your staging network.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Partnerships — LumenTech
elena@lumentech.com
+1 415-555-0162
From: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumentech.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: HQ visit — integration demo + exec tour

Hi Elena — great to hear. Thu, Mar 24 could work; we have availability but will need to stagger arrival windows to avoid crowding the lobby and to ensure escort coverage. A few quick items:

Attachments: visitor_nda-Lumentech.pdf, hq_floor_map.pdf

Proposed flow (high level):
- 10:00–11:00 — Exec overview (Innovation Suite A) — escort + lobby check-in
- 11:15–12:45 — Technical demo (Innovation Suite B) — dedicated LAN port and 10Gb wired patch available on request
- 13:30–15:00 — Breakout sessions (Conference 4 + overflow)
- 15:15–15:45 — Wrap + next steps / mutual action plan

Please review the attached NDA and sign via DocuSign if acceptable. For the wired demo machines, confirm whether you need static IPs pushed to the staging VLAN or we should provide a private NATed subnet.

I cc'd Kimberly and Marissa to handle room bookings and escorts. Once NDA is signed I'll send a calendar invite with visitor instructions and parking pass info.

Best,
Olga Petro
Manager, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumentech.com>
To: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenTech Ops <ops@lumentech.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: HQ visit — integration demo + exec tour

Olga — thanks. I sent the DocuSign back a moment ago (link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC-123-docusign-link). Confirming Thu, Mar 24 as the date. Arrival windows we'd like:
- Execs (6): 09:45–10:05 (brief escorted arrival)
- Engineers + TLs (12): 12:50–13:15 (staggered entrance to avoid lobby queue)

Notes:
- Two presenters will bring laptops with external GPU enclosures (Thunderbolt & PCIe). They'll need a short run to a desk location and access to a 10Gb port.
- We have 3 attendees with dietary restrictions (gluten-free).
- Would like an optional live stream / recording of the exec overview for remote stakeholders.

Can you confirm parking passes for 5 cars and the badge pickup process?

— Elena
From: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: HQ visit — please confirm rooms, AV, escorts, catering

Kimberly / Marissa / Ben — please action the items below. Summary: LumenTech confirmed Mar 24, ~18 attendees split into exec and engineering windows. They will bring 2 demo laptops with external GPU enclosures and requested 10Gb wired access. They want a livestream for the exec overview and 5 parking passes. Attached for ops: demo-checklist.xlsx

Please reply with:
- Room confirmations (Innovation Suite A/B + overflow)
- AV contact & livestream setup (Zoom/Teams RTMP? who manages recordings)
- Escort assignments (exec vs engineering)
- Catering order & dietary notes
- Network contact for VLAN/10Gb port provisioning

Thanks — Olga
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: HQ visit — please confirm rooms, AV, escorts, catering

All set on our side — booking details below. See attached: demo-checklist.xlsx

- Rooms: Innovation Suite B (11:00–15:30) primary; Innovation Suite A reserved 09:30–11:30 for exec overview; Conference 4 reserved as overflow 13:00–16:00.
- AV/Livestream: AV team will provide a widescreen camera + USB/HDMI encoder. We can stream to Zoom with a recording saved to our meeting folder. AV lead: Marco Diaz (av@redwood.com).
- Network: IT (cc'd) will provision two 10Gb patched drops into the Innovation Suite B rack and assign a private /24 NATed subnet for the demo machines. Confirm if presenters need public egress; default will be internal-only access unless they request external access.
- Escorts: Marissa will escort execs; Ben will escort the engineering group for check-in and lab access.
- Catering: Ordered boxed lunches with gluten-free and vegetarian options flagged. Pickup at 12:45 in the main lobby kitchen.
- Parking: 5 visitor passes reserved (Lot C). Please provide license plates 24h prior for gate pre-clear.

Let me know if we should add a livestream backup (recorded-only DSLR) — recommend we do a recording as contingency.

— Kimberly
From: Olga Petro <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumentech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: HQ visit — integration demo + exec tour (final confirmations)

Elena — all confirmed for Thu, Mar 24. Quick recap and next steps:

- NDA: received via DocuSign (thanks).
- Rooming: Innovation Suite A (execs), Innovation Suite B (technical demo), Conference 4 (overflow).
- AV: Marco Diaz (av@redwood.com) will run livestream to Zoom; recording archived to our shared Drive.
- Network: two 10Gb drops reserved and NATed /24; IT will permit outbound egress if you send a request with destination IPs.
- Escorts: Marissa (execs) / Ben (engineers).
- Catering: boxed lunches with GF options — dietary list attached to the calendar invite.
- Parking: 5 passes in Lot C; please send license plates by Wed, Mar 23 10:00 PST.

Calendar invite with visitor instructions, parking pass attachment, and a short pre-visit checklist has been sent to the attendee list. If you need any changes to the agenda or additional equipment (whiteboards, extra monitors), reply and we will update the checklist.

Looking forward to hosting you — Olga
Olga Petro
Manager, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
